units.source_text: 古歌：“思君君不觉，心苦口难言。

en.t: An old poem says: I think of you, but you do not know it; my heart suffers, yet my mouth cannot speak.

units.source_text: 只有疏篱隔，从无见面缘。”见《古今和歌集》。

en.t: Only a sparse fence stands between us, and from the beginning there has been no fate that lets us meet. This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.
